overview.sub: Where the money went, and what you kept.
overview.goodSay: You kept {p} of what you earned. The biggest cost was {top}.
overview.badSay: You spent {n} more than you earned. Most of it was {top}.
overview.noRateSay: {m} has no dollar rate yet, so what you kept can’t be worked out. Add the rate and this fills in.
overview.spentDU: pesos at the month’s rate, plus dollars
overview.nwD: needs account balances; no source sends them yet
overview.stripLabel: This month’s spending, each band a category, as wide as its share
overview.savingsTitle: What you kept, month by month
overview.savingsSub: in dollars at each month’s rate
overview.vsSame: About the same as your typical month.
overview.vsUp: {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} better than your typical month.
overview.vsDown: {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} below your typical month.
overview.vsNone: After three months with a dollar rate, this compares with your typical month.
overview.typicalNote: Typical includes {l}, when you came up short.
overview.splitGood: You spent {s} of what you earned and kept {k}.
overview.splitBad: You spent {o} more than you earned.
overview.todoReview: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing is waiting for your review} one {# transaction is waiting for your review} other {# transactions are waiting for your review}}
overview.todoImports: {n, plural, =0 {No import needs a look} one {# import needs a look} other {# imports need a look}}
overview.spendSame: In dollars, about the same as a typical month.
overview.spendMore: In dollars, you spent {p} more than in a typical month.
overview.spendLess: In dollars, you spent {p} less than in a typical month.
overview.timeAll: You kept something in each of the last {m} months.
overview.timeSome: You kept something in {k} of the last {m} months.
overview.timeNone: No month has a dollar rate yet.
overview.dotted: The dotted line is your typical month.
overview.missingBody: Its peso spending is left out of every dollar figure until you add one.

transactions.sub: Every row from every source, with your review choices applied. Text from files is shown exactly as it arrived.
transactions.choiceKept: Your choice is kept apart from the imported row and survives a re-import of the same month.
transactions.fixInSourceBody: Rows from that source are corrected in the file and uploaded again. Only Mercado Pago rows can be changed here.

review.sub: Rows the importers weren’t sure about. Approve them or pick a better category; your totals move within seconds.

reasons.needs_review: No category, or a transfer that may be spending
reasons.possible_duplicate: Same amount, place and day as another row
reasons.bcv_rate: Converted at the official Venezuelan rate
reasons.summed: A month total, not single purchases

imports.sub: Upload a file from each source. A new file for the same month replaces the old one, and you can undo it.

rules.mercadopago: The monthly release report as CSV. One month per file, up to 5 MiB.
rules.notion: The notes log exported as Markdown (.md). The whole log, up to 5 MiB.
rules.excel: A monthly budget whose name ends in the month and year, like budget_Sep_2026.xlsx. Up to 20 MiB.

imports.inUseYes: Yes, these are the rows you see
imports.skippedTitle: {n, plural, one {# row was skipped; the rest came in.} other {# rows were skipped; the rest came in.}}
imports.stalledBody: Repair finishes it from the file already uploaded. Nothing is lost.
imports.reading: Reading rows. Totals update about a minute after it finishes.
imports.undoBody: Brings back the rows from the file before this one for {p}.

errors.name: The file name needs the month and year, like budget_Jun_2026.xlsx.
errors.never: The file never arrived. It may have been over the 20 MiB limit.

rates.sub: One rate per month turns pesos into dollars for the dollar view. Your records keep the original currency.
rates.rtFoot: Rates keep two decimals. Changing one updates that month’s dollar figures at once.

data.sub: What Cuenta stores about you, where it lives, and how to take it out or remove it.
data.sTxD: every row from your files, with the original text
data.sFilesD: kept so an import can be undone or repaired
data.sChoicesD: categories and approvals for Mercado Pago rows
data.storedFoot: Everything is encrypted and kept in one cloud account, filed under your sign-in. Nobody else’s sign-in can read it.
data.exportBody: Download every transaction as a CSV file with your review choices applied. Text that looks like a spreadsheet formula is made safe first.
data.delBody: Removes every transaction, file, choice and rate. You can’t undo it from here. Export first if you want a copy.
data.delBackup: Backups keep deleted records for 35 days before they’re gone for good. A note that an erase happened, with its time, is kept so nothing deleted comes back.
data.deleting: Deleting {a, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} and {b, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}…
data.deletedBody: Imports reopen at 14:35, after background work finishes, so nothing deleted can come back.

states.errB: The server didn’t answer in time. Your data is safe.

dashboard.title: No money in yet
dashboard.text: Import a Mercado Pago report, your notes log or a monthly budget, and your overview fills in here.

transactions.title: No transactions match
transactions.text: Nothing in these months matches the filters. Widen the months or clear the search.

review.title: Nothing to review
review.text: Every flagged row has a category and is approved. New flags show up here after each import.

imports.title: No imports yet
imports.text: Choose where the file comes from, then drop it here. Each file replaces the earlier one for the same month.

rates.title: No months to rate
rates.text: Rates show up once you have peso rows. Each month needs one rate for the dollar view.

data.title: Nothing stored
data.text: You have no transactions, files or rates stored. Export and delete stay available.

common.footer: Sign out when you’re done; the session also ends after 30 idle minutes.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: Bring your own files and see where your money goes. It takes about three minutes.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short phrase works well.
signUp.privacyBody: Cuenta keeps the files you import and the rows inside them. Nobody else’s account can read yours. You can export or erase everything at any time.
signUp.accept: I have read the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy> and accept the <terms>terms</terms>.
signUp.proof: When you press the button, your browser runs a short check, a few seconds long, to keep automated sign-ups out. There is nothing to solve.
signUp.errWeak: That password is too short or too common. Use at least 12 characters and avoid common words.
signUp.errLimit: Too many sign-ups from this connection. Try again in an hour.
signUp.errBot: The check didn’t pass, so we haven’t created an account. Reload the page and try again, or write to {contact}.

confirm.title: Check your email
confirm.lead: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. The account is created once you enter it. The code works for 15 minutes.
confirm.spam: Nothing yet? Look in your spam folder first.
confirm.resent: We sent a new code. The old one no longer works.
confirm.resentWait: You can ask for another one in 30 seconds.
confirm.errWrong: That code doesn’t match. Check the digits and try again.
confirm.errExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.

setup.title: Set up your authenticator
setup.lead: Cuenta asks for a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in. It keeps your money private even if someone learns your password.
setup.required: You can’t see any money screen until this is done.
setup.step1: Open an authenticator app on your phone and scan this square.
setup.step2: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.cantScan: Can’t scan? Type this key instead:
setup.errWrong: That code didn’t work. Codes change every 30 seconds, so type the newest one.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Type your email and password. Your authenticator code comes next.
signIn.errWrong: That email and password don’t match. Check both and try again.

code.title: Enter your code
code.lead: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Cuenta.
code.errWrong: That code didn’t work. Type the newest one from your app.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Type your email. If there’s an account, we’ll send you a code.
reset.sentLead: If {email} has an account, a code is on its way. It can take a minute.

resetConfirm.title: Choose a new password
resetConfirm.lead: Type the code from your email and your new password. You’ll still need your authenticator code to sign in.
resetConfirm.errWrong: That code doesn’t match or has expired. Check your email, or ask for a new one.

lost.title: Lost your authenticator?
lost.lead: You can’t reset it on your own. That protects your money if someone else gets your password.
lost.step1: Write to {contact} from the email you signed up with.
lost.step2: Say that you lost your authenticator. Never send your password or a code.
lost.step3: We check it’s you and reset it. You set up a new one the next time you sign in.
lost.wait: A person answers, so it can take a day or two.

consent.title: Your data, in plain words
consent.lead: We changed this page. Read it, then accept to keep using Cuenta. You can find it again any time under Your data.
consent.leadRead: This is what you agree to when you create an account. You accept it once, on the sign-up page.
consent.keep1: The files you import, and every row inside them with its original text.
consent.keep2: Your review choices and your dollar rates.
consent.keep3: Your email, and the date you accepted this page.
consent.where: In one cloud account, filed under your sign-in. No other account can read it.
consent.howLong: Until you erase it. After that, backups keep it for 35 days, then it’s gone for good.
consent.remove: Export or erase everything, or delete your account, at any time from Your data.
consent.accept: I have read the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy> and accept the <terms>terms</terms>.
consent.record: We record that you accepted, with the date and the version of this page.

delete.reauthLead: To delete your account, sign in again. That stops anyone using a computer you left open.
delete.warnLead: This erases everything and closes your account. It can’t be undone from here.
delete.warn1: Every transaction, file, review choice and dollar rate.
delete.warn2: Your sign-in. To come back, you’d sign up again.
delete.backups: Backups keep your data for 35 days, then it’s gone for good. Export first if you want a copy.
delete.working: Erasing {tx} transactions and {files} files, then ending your sessions…
delete.stay: Stay on this page until it finishes.
delete.partialTitle: Your account is closed, but not everything is erased
delete.partialLead: Every session has ended and you can’t sign in. We couldn’t erase {left} transactions yet. We keep trying; you don’t need to do anything.
delete.partialHelp: Questions? Write to {contact} and quote the reference below.
delete.doneLead: You’re signed out on every device. Here’s what we removed.
delete.doneNote: This page is the only record. We can’t show it again.
delete.doneBackups: Backups keep it for 35 days, then it’s gone for good.

tooMany.title: Too many tries
tooMany.signIn: For your safety, sign-in is paused for this account. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
tooMany.signUp: Too many sign-ups came from this connection. Try again in an hour.
tooMany.code: Too many wrong codes. Wait {minutes} minutes, then type the newest code from your app.
tooMany.wait: Waiting is the only fix. Trying again sooner won’t help.

notFound.label: Not found
notFound.title: We can’t find that page
notFound.lead: The address may be old or mistyped. Your money is exactly where you left it.

idle.banner: You were signed out after 30 minutes without activity. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
